about.text: Strata on shadcn/ui. Spec: DESIGN.md (repo root). Components and the live sidebar are real shadcn/ui 4.23 (Radix, Tailwind v4) from the Strata UI bundle (design/strata-ui), themed with the Radix custom palette from #21206D, Atkinson Hyperlegible, 44 px controls and Lucide icons. Press Play to use them. Today and Sign in are set aside for now. All data is fictional.

liveNotes.text: Real shadcn/ui shell after the 2026-11-11 critique: seven pages always shown (Today, Projects, Inbox; Storage units: Receive, Inventory, Retention; Soils: Lab programs, Workboard; Concrete: Breaks, Receiving, Specimens, Holds, Review), 36 px rows, a 36 px Search or scan field that opens the Ctrl K command menu (clicking it does the same), Pinned records. Collapsed (Ctrl+B) every item is a 44 px icon with a tooltip; Retention and Pinned open their pages in a menu to the right. Inbox (was My requests) holds every notification and action request; hovering the bell previews the latest, clicking it opens Inbox. The board below shows the shared LAB station (recording as, Switch user). Press Play to try it.

settingsNotes.text: Settings mock-up: a modal over the shell (shadcn Dialog), opened from the account menu. Left: search and the app's real settings sections (You: Profile, Preferences, Notifications, My access; Lab: Staff, Locations, Printers, Receiving, Lab tests, Templates; Concrete: Equipment, Suppliers, Holidays, Report header; Admin: System status). Sections a person can't use would be hidden. Right: the open page, here a new Preferences page (theme, table rows, sidebar start, date format, week start, lab time zone, scan behaviour). Proposed: Preferences and its options are new; the rest exist today as /settings pages.

sidebarNotes.text: Sidebar mock, for revision. shadcn Sidebar: SidebarHeader (lab switcher + New), search, SidebarGroup with collapsible labels, SidebarMenuSub for Concrete, SidebarFooter holds only the account row; clicking it opens the account menu (Settings, Help, Feedback & bugs, Sign out), as in Notion and Linear. From Linear: lab switcher at the top, Inbox and My requests above the groups, collapsible group labels, dense 32 px rows. From Notion: search field in the sidebar with Ctrl K, Pinned records, folded Recent. Collapses to icons (48 px). Open questions: search moves from the top bar into the sidebar; Inbox replaces the bell; Inbox shows a dot, not a number.

signinNotes.text: Sign in, shaped 2026-11-11. Each computer remembers its kind: a normal computer shows Sign in with Microsoft; a computer set up as the LAB station opens straight to the LAB form. Each links to the other. After LAB, step 2 asks Who is working here? and the app opens under that name. This changes today's model, where LAB picks the person on each receipt. Proposed and open: an admin marks a computer as the station (a setting saved in that browser); the picker lists receiving-lab staff; Someone else… finds any staff member. Session length (D38) is deferred, so no end time is shown. Wording of every state is the app's current wording.

todayNotes.text: Today on a LAB station, shaped 2026-11-11. Two equal receiving buttons (Receive samples, Receive concrete), then At this station: draft receipts to finish, deliveries waiting, breaks due today, labels to print, each with a count and a way in. No greeting: the sidebar shows who is recording. Each LAB computer picks its rows with Customize this station (saved on that computer). Open: who may customise (proposed: anyone at the station); whether the two buttons are customisable too (fixed for now). The staff (own account) Today comes later.

todayLeadNotes.text: Own-account Today, shaped 2026-11-11, drawn for a project lead first. Welcome with the date and a one-line summary; shortcuts (Request lab testing, Review concrete reports, My projects, New project); then Needs you (two thirds: stage tag, sentence, IDs in mono, one action, most urgent first, first six then Show all) beside Last 24 hours on their projects (one third). No Storage room. Open: what other roles see; whether shortcuts can be changed (fixed for now).

todayManagerNotes.text: Lab Manager Today, 2026-11-11: the project lead's layout with the manager's content (Claude's choices, from PRODUCT.md's description of the role). Shortcuts: Workboard, Breaks due today, Retention due, Disposal scan. Needs you: concrete sets on HOLD, unassigned lab requests, breaks due today, units approved for disposal; longer lists add old draft receipts and location checks that disagree. Last 24 hours covers the whole lab, not one person's projects.

todayTechNotes.text: Technician Today, 2026-11-11: the same layout with a technician's content (Claude's choices, from PRODUCT.md). Shortcuts: Receive, Move storage units, Print labels, My tests. Needs you: tests assigned today, units to pull for a lab program, own draft receipts, a label that didn't print; longer lists add a move to confirm and tests waiting on a sample. Last 24 hours is the person's own work ('You received…').

inboxNotes.text: Inbox, shaped 2026-11-11: every action request and notification in one place. List and detail (like Linear). One stream, newest first, requests above updates on the same day; a request has a filled Request pill and a filled circle-dot, an update an outline bell. Tabs: All, Requests, Updates, Done. View: One stream or Grouped, here and in Settings > Preferences. Requests close on their own when the real action is done. FLAG: on the LAB station anyone who picks a name can open that person's Inbox (no per-person password). Options: keep it, show the station only requests, or confirm before opening.
